portInfo.description: Norwegian port city on the west coast, known for its Viking history and as the homeland of Norway's first kings.

facts.established: Founded 1854, but area has Viking Age history
facts.significance: Important port in the Norwegian Fjord region

size.annualVisitors: Popular stop on Norwegian fjord cruises

climate.description: Temperate oceanic climate with mild winters and cool summers

politics.visaRequirements: Schengen Area rules apply, visa-free for many nationalities
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required, EU citizens need ID card

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Terminal located close to city center
